state_preserved.short_anchor: The original source is the local output; no proposed patches are present. Applied 0; excluded or rolled back 2; held 0.
state_preserved.reason: Source and actual output are identical; the receipt records rolledback with p1 and p2 rejected and no selected patches. The annotation preserves that state and local-only release.

concrete_issue_recoverable.reason: The annotation pairs 3% with the supplied 21%-to-24%/3-percentage-point evidence and Friday with the supplied Saturday schedule evidence. Both unresolved statuses are attributed to supplied review.

overclaim.short_anchor: Factual truth is not independently verified; question resolution is not adjudicated.
overclaim.reason: The annotation describes local review status and explicitly withholds truth and resolution claims. Quoted concerns, where present, remain attributed review assertions.

noop_overcorrection.reason: The output is unchanged due to rollback and has supplied unresolved issues; this is not the empty-issue no-op case.
